entities.name: 2-Bromo-4-(piperazin-1-yl)-1-(trifluoromethyl)benzene
observations: A brominated aryl piperazine bearing a trifluoromethyl group; the aryl bromide is retained in the matched product.

entities.name: Heteroaryl acetic acid
observations: Encoded as O=C(O)C[n]1ccc2cccnc21; serves as the carboxylic-acid coupling partner.

entities.name: Piperazine amide product
observations: Matched product is O=C(Cn1ccc2cccnc21)N1CCN(c2ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc2Br)CC1, formed by acylation of secondary piperazine nitrogen.

entities.name: TBTU coupling conditions
observations: Recorded plausible conditions include a TBTU-like uronium reagent, triethylamine, dichloromethane, tetrafluoroborate counterion, and water; temperature and duration were not reported.
